About Collens Group

We build websites, apps, games and AI solutions for businesses in the Netherlands, Belgium and the rest of the world, with a fixed price up front and a free concept before you pay anything.

What we do

Collens Group is a small, independent digital company. We build websites and web shops, apps for iPhone and Android, games and AI automation and chatbots.

Who is behind it?

Collens Group was founded by Jeffrey Collens. He builds with modern AI tools and checks every concept, every text and every delivery himself before it goes to a client. So you email directly with the maker, not with an account manager.

Get a free quote

Where we work

Anywhere. We work fully online, by email and video, with businesses in the Netherlands and Belgium and beyond, for example in the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia and New Zealand. You can work with us in English or Dutch. Prices are the same final prices in euros everywhere.

How we work

  • Fixed price up front. You know what you pay before we start. Extra work only after your approval.
  • A free concept first. Within 48 hours you see what it can look like, made for your business, with no obligation.
  • Final prices. No VAT is added.
  • You stay the owner. The site, the domain and the content are in your name; apps are published on your own Apple and Google accounts and the source code is yours after the final payment.
  • Honest about what we don't do. We don't build large 3D games or online multiplayer, and we don't work on location.

What we built ourselves

What we make for ourselves, we make for you. LubbyC is a travel app, Koffer Vol! a packing puzzle with 100 levels in 10 countries, Eiland Express a 3D driving game and Manu en Khanun an animated series for children. See them on the projects page.

Frequently asked questions

How do I contact you?

Use the contact form on our home page or email info@collensgroup.com. You get a reply within 48 hours, in English or Dutch. Tell us briefly what your business does and what you would like to have built; that is enough for us to start on your free concept. We work fully online, by email and video, so it does not matter where you are.

Do you work with clients in my country?

Most likely yes. We work fully online, by email and video, with clients worldwide, in English or Dutch, for example in the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia and New Zealand. Prices are the same final prices in euros everywhere. We set up payment methods and texts that fit your country and your customers.

Who owns what you build?

You do. After the final payment everything we built for you is yours: the code, the design and the content. Websites and domains are registered in your name, and apps are published on your own Apple and Google developer accounts. If you later want to work with someone else, you take everything with you.
